name: Fully Automatic High-Precision Lamination Machine
summary: Designed specifically for glass and display modules. Lamination accuracy refined to ±0.075mm, equipped with constant pressure control, cycle time as fast as 80 seconds.
contentHtml:
The fully automatic high-precision laminating machine is a high-end intelligent equipment independently developed by TXAM, specifically designed for high-precision lamination of glass and display modules.

Working Principle

The equipment adopts a precision mechanical structure combined with an advanced motion control system to achieve automatic feeding, precise positioning, high-precision lamination, and pressure holding. The entire process is automatically controlled to ensure lamination accuracy and consistent quality.

Technical Advantages

  • Lamination accuracy reaches ±0.075mm, far exceeding industry standards
  • Constant pressure function ensures firm lamination without bubbles
  • 80-second ultra-fast cycle time, greatly improving production efficiency
  • Supports multiple product sizes with high flexibility

Application Fields

Widely used in glass lamination processes for electronic products such as televisions, educational displays, and commercial display screens.
